naslov: Dallas takes on Indiana in non-conference action
tekst:
Indiana Pacers (3-7, 11th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 10th in the Western Conference)
              Dallas; Monday, 8 p.m. EST
              LINE: Mavericks -4.5; over/under is 221.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Dallas and Indiana face off in non-conference action.
              Dallas went 26-56 overall last season while going 16-25 at home. The Mavericks gave up 119.6 points per game while committing 18.4 fouls last season.
              Indiana finished 19-63 overall with an 8-33 record on the road a season ago. The Pacers shot 45.8% from the field and 35.6% from 3-point range last season.
              The teams square off for the second time this season. The Mavericks won the last meeting 121-105 on Oct. 23, with Kyrie Irving scoring 24 points in the win.
              INJURIES: Mavericks: Tarik Biberovic: out (heel), Sergio De Larrea: out (knee), Dereck Lively II: out (foot).
              Pacers: Tyrese Haliburton: out (hamstring), T.J. McConnell: day to day (hamstring), Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl).
